page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-384 is a virtual machine instance within the c4d server family, built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. It is equipped with 384 dedicated vCPUs and 1488 GB of system memory, which provides a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 3.88 GB per vCPU. This balanced allocation of compute and memory resources supports high-density parallel processing tasks.

The instance does not include local NVMe SSD storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all data persistence must be handled through network-attached block storage. Additionally, the configuration does not provide any complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring external networking solutions for public internet connectivity.

With its high core count and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is designed for large-scale CPU-bound workloads. It is suited for enterprise applications, distributed data processing, and compute-heavy web serving where local storage and hardware acceleration are not required.
